title: Preserve or explain a kept root acknowledgement across an adopted Claude turn
outcome: After a user re-acknowledges the same held root, an intervening adopted Claude turn either leaves the still-valid acknowledgement for the next ordinary opening or the next opening explains that the adopted turn consumed it.
acceptance: A deterministic adopted-turn regression shows whether the later ordinary turn uses the kept acknowledgement or gives the concrete refusal reason, with no expansion of adopted source authority.
